about.title: Build your cycling legacy.
about.intro: ProPeloton Manager is an online cycling management game where players create and develop a cycling team, prepare race calendars, manage riders, handle finances, negotiate transfers, follow rankings, and compete across a long season-based cycling world.
about.what1: ProPeloton Manager is designed for players who enjoy cycling, strategy, long-term planning, and multiplayer competition. Instead of controlling a rider directly, you act as the manager of a cycling club. Your job is to build a balanced squad, prepare races, protect finances, develop riders, handle support staff, improve facilities, and make decisions that affect the full season.
about.what2: The game world includes race calendars, team rankings, race preparation, stage plans, equipment, training, staff, sponsors, transfers, financial management, and developing-team systems. Every club has to balance ambition with long-term stability.
about.teamText: Build your squad with sprinters, climbers, time-trial riders, helpers, leaders, and young riders. Contracts, morale, fatigue, potential, and development all matter.
about.raceText: Apply for races, select riders, assign staff and assets, choose equipment, prepare supplies, and create stage plans before deadlines.
about.seasonText: Teams earn points, climb rankings, manage sponsors, pay salaries, and plan for promotion, relegation, and long-term club growth.
about.developmentText: ProPeloton Manager is actively being built and improved. Game systems, balancing, race simulation, user interface, notifications, and economy values may continue to change as the game develops. The goal is to create a deep cycling manager experience that is fair, understandable, and sustainable for players over many seasons.

how.title: Manage the team, master the season.
how.intro: ProPeloton Manager is about making connected decisions. Every race, transfer, training choice, sponsor objective, and financial move can affect the future of your club.
how.step1Text: Start by creating your cycling team identity. Your club becomes the center of your season: riders, finances, race calendar, sponsors, transfers, equipment, and rankings all connect back to your team.
how.step2Text: Review your riders before making big decisions. A strong team needs different rider types such as sprinters, climbers, time-trial riders, helpers, rouleurs, and leaders. Overall rating is useful, but exact skills and rider roles matter more in many races.
how.step3Text: Training improves riders over time, but too much intensity can create fatigue. A tired team may perform worse even if the riders look strong on paper. Good managers balance development, recovery, morale, and race goals.
how.step4Text: The race calendar includes different categories, countries, routes, and stage types. Choose races that fit your squad. A small or young team should not overload riders with too many events.
how.step5Text: Accepted entry is not enough. Before a race, managers prepare riders, staff, team cars, equipment, supplies, and tactical plans. Stage races also need stage-by-stage planning.
how.step6Text: Your club has income and expenses. Salaries, staff, equipment, infrastructure, training camps, sponsors, taxes, travel, and race operations all affect your balance. Financial discipline is part of long-term success.
how.systemsText: The game combines sporting and management systems. Winning races is only one part of the challenge. A successful manager also protects the budget, builds the future squad, improves staff and facilities, and keeps riders ready for important events.
how.timeText: ProPeloton Manager uses in-game time for race deadlines, training camps, transfers, finance periods, and season flow. Managers should always check the displayed game time and prepare before the final deadline. Missing a deadline can leave a team badly prepared for an important race.

support.title: Help for players and visitors.
support.intro: This page explains how to contact ProPeloton Manager support, what details to include in a report, and where to go for account, gameplay, payment, coin, or technical questions.
support.contactText: The fastest way to contact support is through the contact form. It sends your message directly to ProPeloton Manager support without opening your email app.
support.accountText: Use support if you cannot sign in, cannot access your club, have trouble with password reset, or believe your account data is not loading correctly.
support.bugsText: Report bugs with clear steps. Include the page name, expected behavior, actual behavior, team name, rider name, race name, and screenshots when possible.
support.paymentsText: For coin package, Stripe checkout, rewarded-ad, or balance questions, include your account email and the approximate time of the issue.
support.gameplayText: Ask about race preparation, stage plans, transfers, sponsors, finances, rankings, training, fatigue, or any system that is unclear.
support.fasterText: A good support request should explain the problem clearly. For bugs, tell us what you clicked, what page you were on, what you expected, and what actually happened. For account or coin issues, include your account email and the approximate date/time of the problem.
support.sensitiveText: Never send your password, full payment card information, or private authentication codes. Support does not need those details.

privacy.heroText: Learn what information ProPeloton Manager may collect, how it is used, and how account, game, Premium, and payment data are handled.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy for ProPeloton Manager
privacy.s1p1: ProPeloton Manager is an online cycling management game. This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected, how it is used, when it may be shared with service providers, and how players can contact us about privacy questions.
privacy.s2p1: We may collect account information such as email address, username, profile details, authentication identifiers, team information, game progress, in-game actions, support messages, and technical information needed to operate the game safely.
privacy.s2p2: Game data can include club details, riders, staff, finances, race preparation, notifications, rankings, purchases, coin balance, Premium status, subscriptions, service activations, and other gameplay records connected to the account.
privacy.s3p1: ProPeloton Manager may offer Premium subscriptions, coin packages, and other paid features. Payment processing is handled by external payment providers such as Stripe. We do not store complete payment-card numbers or security codes on our own application servers.
privacy.s3p2: We may receive and store payment-related records from Stripe, including customer identifiers, subscription identifiers, checkout-session identifiers, invoice identifiers, payment status, billing reason, currency, amount paid, subscription period, cancellation status, and timestamps.
privacy.s3p3: We use these records to activate or end Premium access, grant monthly coins after successful payments, process one-time coin purchases, display billing history, prevent duplicate grants, manage cancellation, investigate payment errors, and respond to refunds, disputes, reversals, or fraud.
privacy.s4p1: ProPeloton Manager does not currently use third-party advertising. If this changes in the future, this Privacy Policy will be updated before those services are used.
privacy.s5p1: We may use cookies, browser storage, and similar technologies for login, session handling, preferences, security, Stripe-return handling, analytics, tutorial progress, and game functionality.
privacy.s6p1: We use information to operate the game, maintain player accounts, process gameplay actions, show rankings and race results, provide support, prevent abuse, improve performance, handle Premium and coin payments, maintain transaction history, and comply with legal or platform requirements.
privacy.s7p1: We may share limited information with service providers that help operate the game, including hosting, database, authentication, payment processing, email, analytics, monitoring, and support tools.
privacy.s7p2: Stripe receives and processes payment and billing information needed to provide checkout, recurring billing, invoices, payment methods, subscription management, refunds, and dispute handling. Stripe processes this information under its own privacy terms.
privacy.s7p3: We do not sell player account information as a standalone product.
privacy.s8p1: We retain account and game data while the account is active and for as long as reasonably needed to operate the game, maintain game history, resolve support requests, prevent abuse, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.s8p2: Payment, invoice, coin-ledger, subscription, refund, dispute, and fraud-prevention records may be retained longer where necessary for accounting, tax, legal, security, and payment-provider requirements.
privacy.s9p1: We use technical and organizational measures to protect account, game, Premium, and transaction data. No online service can guarantee perfect security, but we work to keep the game reliable and safe.
privacy.s10p1: Depending on applicable law, you may have rights relating to access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or portability of personal information. Some game, payment, or security records may need to be retained where retention is legally required or necessary to protect the service.
privacy.s11Prefix: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at

terms.s2p2: The game is actively developed. Features, balancing, prices, economy values, race systems, user interface, and availability may change over time. Premium convenience features do not guarantee better race results, transfer acceptance, or access to hidden rider skills.
terms.s3p1: You are responsible for your account activity. Do not share your login details, attempt to access another account, or use the game in a way that disrupts other players.
terms.s4p1: Players must not exploit bugs, manipulate systems, automate prohibited actions, interfere with the service, attempt fraud, or abuse payments, referrals, rankings, Premium access, coins, or any other game system.
terms.s4p2: We may restrict access, reverse unfair gains, remove abusive content, correct balances, or suspend accounts when reasonably necessary to protect the game and other players.

terms.s5p2: Coin packages are optional one-time purchases processed through an external payment provider such as Stripe. Buying coins does not activate Premium membership.
terms.s5p3: Once payment is completed and the coins are credited, the purchase is final, except where a refund is required by applicable law or where we confirm a duplicate, unauthorized, or technically incorrect charge.

terms.s6p1: ProPeloton Premium is an optional monthly subscription. The current monthly price and included monthly coin reward are shown before checkout.
terms.s6p2: Premium begins after successful payment confirmation and renews automatically each month using the payment method managed by Stripe, unless future renewal is cancelled before the next billing date.
terms.s6p3: You may cancel future renewal at any time through Manage Subscription. Premium normally remains active until the current paid period ends, after which normal free game access continues.
terms.s6p4: Unused coins normally remain in the account after Premium cancellation. If a Premium payment is refunded, reversed, disputed, fraudulent, or unauthorized, Premium access and coins connected to that payment may be removed or corrected.
terms.s7p1: If a Premium renewal payment fails, the payment provider may retry the charge. Premium access may remain temporarily active while payment is processed. If payment is not completed, Premium access may end while the account, club, game progress, and normal free access remain available.
terms.s8p1: Coin-package purchases are non-refundable as described above. Premium refund requests involving duplicate charges, unauthorized payments, technical billing errors, or failure to provide the purchased service may be reviewed individually.
terms.s8p2: Nothing in these terms removes consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded. Where applicable law requires a refund, cancellation right, withdrawal right, or other remedy, that legal requirement takes priority.
